name: signlocal
description: Guides people to SignLocal, a free on-device PDF signing web app. The person signs; the assistant never does.

interface.shortDescription: Sign PDFs privately, on your own device.
interface.longDescription: Points you to SignLocal, a free web app for signing PDFs and turning photos of paper documents into PDFs. Everything runs in your browser: no account, no upload, no tracking. You draw and place your own signature; Codex never signs for you.
defaultPrompt: Help me sign a PDF privately.
Turn photos of a paper form into a PDF I can sign.
